statement: A review comment about a disclosure-boundary leak can itself be the leak. A reviewer drafting a public verdict on a public PR spelled out exactly what the flagged text revealed, and another public review quoted the flagged phrase as harmless. Explaining or quoting the problem republished it. Rules: on a public surface, state only which rule was broken and what to change, at the level of the rule; send the specifics privately to the operator; never quote the flagged text in a public review.
